title: openai-compat: support Responses API variants + seed/determinism + metadata passthrough
author: Jordan Lee
description: Add compatibility for newer OpenAI Responses API variants and surface seed/determinism flags + metadata passthrough across SDK -> gateway -> runtime. Motivation: customers are adopting Responses-style endpoints (structured output, multi-turn response envelopes) and expect parity with OpenAI flags like `seed`/`deterministic` and arbitrary `metadata` to be preserved through the request lifecycle for downstream attribution and evals. This PR implements: 1) responses adapter that normalizes Responses v1/v1betaX payloads to our internal request model, 2) explicit seed/determinism passthrough so the runtime and model selection layer can surface deterministic outputs where supported, 3) metadata passthrough from incoming requests into response envelopes and audit logs, 4) streaming stability fixes for SSE/chunk framing when sending Responses-style events and function/tool-calling boundaries, and 5) docs + SDK examples for Python/TS. Checklist: [x] adapter impl, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests (flaky e2e rerun), [x] docs, [x] changelog. Related: ENG-4821 (Responses compatibility), ENG-4990 (determinism flags).
commits: feat(openai-compat): add responses_adapter to normalize Responses API payloads
feat(sdk): expose seed and deterministic flags in python/ts SDK wrappers
fix(streaming): stabilize SSE framing and handle function-call boundaries during streaming
test: add unit/integration tests for seed/metadata passthrough and responses variants
ci: fix linter warnings and re-run flaky e2e tests
ci_checks: e2e-tests: pass (rerun due to intermittent timeout)
review_conversation: Priya Sharma: Great to see Responses compatibility. Can we make sure the adapter explicitly rejects unsupported beta fields rather than silently dropping them?
Jordan Lee: Good point — adapter now validates unknown top-level keys and logs a single analytic event for dropped fields (keeps behavior explicit).
Miguel Torres: The deterministic flag needs to be plumbed to scheduling so we avoid batching that would break determinism. Have you added tests?

Jordan Lee: Yes — added integration tests that run the deterministic path under single-request scheduling and assert repeatability across runs. Also added docs noting that determinism may be best-effort depending on model/backing variant.
Leah Kim: Streaming fix looks fine but please add a comment explaining the buffer flush heuristic used to avoid split UTF-8 sequences in SSE chunks.
Jordan Lee: Added inline comment and unit test that asserts no invalid UTF-8 sequences are emitted when streaming large unicode payloads.
Priya Sharma: Approving pending minor docs tweak.
release_notes: OpenAI Responses compatibility: normalized Responses API variants; seed/determinism flags exposed and plumbed to the runtime; metadata passthrough preserved for audit & eval; streaming stability fixes for Responses-style events; SDK examples and docs added.
